bays.restriction: Controlled parking zone — permit, visitor voucher or paid parking in marked bays (bay signs carry a two-letter code: zone letter + bay type, e.g. BR = Brixton resident bay)
bays.tariff: Emission-based on-street tariff — Central Lambeth (Lambeth Council: CPZs north of the South Circular except Waterloo and Kennington): £5.68 per hour (band A) to £11.20 (band M), or £19.61 for a band M diesel, off-peak; peak £6.25 (band A) to £21.57 (band M diesel). Your vehicle's CO2 emissions band (A = lowest to M = highest) and fuel set the price; diesel pays a surcharge (included in the diesel figures). The first 15 minutes cost 25% of the hourly rate. Peak rate applies 10am to 1pm; off-peak at other controlled times. Full A–M band table on Lambeth's emission-based parking charges page
